entities.summary: Uprising and Militarization, a transformative movement in Syria (2011–2014). Emerged from Daraa protests erupt — beginning of the Syrian uprising. Catalyzed Ghouta chemical attack kills hundreds — crosses Obama's 'red line' and ISIS declares its 'caliphate' spanning Syria and Iraq.
